title: The "Last Lecture" by Randy Pausch
summary: Randy Pausch, a Carnegie Mellon computer scientist and virtual reality pioneer who was dying of cancer, gives his 'Last Lecture' about achieving childhood dreams and living well. The recording is a full-length talk of about 104 minutes.
why: HN commenters recommend it as an emotionally powerful life-advice talk and revisit it as a reminder of mortality.

quote.text: I often times revisit Randy Pausch's The Last Lecture[1] to act as a memento mori[2].
